description:
NEXUS NOVA – Connecting Minds. Exploring Infinity.

What happens to the things we leave behind when humanity reaches for the stars? Every piece of equipment abandoned on the Moon and Mars carries a story of human curiosity, sacrifice, and discovery. Our mission is not simply to show what humanity left behind, but to remind the world of the dreams, determination, and incredible achievements that took us there.

Because not everything left behind is forgotten. Some things become part of our legacy.
summary:
"Abandoned but not Forgotten" is a storytelling project that explores the forgotten history of NASA's discarded equipment on the Moon and Mars. Through storytelling, we bring attention to the spacecraft, rovers, scientific instruments, and other equipment left behind during space exploration missions.

Each abandoned object has a story to tell. These objects represent human curiosity, scientific discoveries, technological achievements, and the challenges of exploring other worlds. Although their missions may have ended, their contributions to space exploration remain valuable.

Our project aims to help people understand the historical and scientific importance of these objects and see them not merely as abandoned equipment, but as reminders of humanity's journey beyond Earth.
details:
Project Details – Abandoned but not Forgotten

Our project, "Abandoned but not Forgotten," is a storytelling presentation that explores the history of NASA's discarded equipment on the Moon and Mars.

Through storytelling, we bring the forgotten objects of space exploration back into focus. We explain what these objects are, why they were sent into space, what missions they were part of, and why they were left behind.

The project highlights the scientific value, historical importance, and technological achievements represented by these objects. It helps audiences understand that even after a mission ends, the equipment left behind continues to tell an important story about human exploration.

We use Microsoft PowerPoint to create and present our storytelling project. Our creative approach combines space exploration facts with engaging storytelling to make the topic interesting and understandable.

The main aim is to create awareness about the history of space exploration and remind people that these abandoned objects are not forgotten pieces of equipment, but valuable reminders of humanity's journey beyond Earth.
